metadata.name: keys.event
metadata.description: the last key event as plain data {type,key,code,mods,editable} — the input stream, observable by anything reactive

metadata.name: keys.pressed
metadata.description: the currently-held key set (Record<key,true>) — game-style consumers poll this

metadata.name: keys.active
metadata.description: the active app name — keys.route consults keys.map.<active>

metadata.name: keys.capture
metadata.description: the document keydown/keyup handler (dispatch): writes keys.event + keys.pressed, then routes on keydown. Attach via document|keydown|(dispatch "keys.capture").

metadata.name: keys.route
metadata.description: match the event against keys.map.<keys.active> + dispatch the action (first match wins; honors inEditable/mods/preventDefault)

metadata.name: keys.blur
metadata.description: clear keys.pressed (the stuck-key fix on window blur). Attach via window|blur|(dispatch "keys.blur").
